parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The AppName of the live stream. View AppNames on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

parameters.name: Delay
parameters.description: The delay in milliseconds before the SEI is inserted after the command is received.

parameters.name: Pattern
parameters.description:
Specifies the insertion pattern for the SEI.

- **keyframe**: Inserts at every keyframe.

- **frame**: Inserts at every single frame.

parameters.name: Repeat
parameters.description: The number of times to repeat the insertion. A value of -1 means infinite repetitions.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description:
The name of the live stream.

> It must be the name of the source stream. This ensures that SEI is inserted into all transcoded streams.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The SEI text. Length limit: 4000 bytes.
